title: Exception while typechecking python3.4 program using asyncio.Queue.get
body:


Here is a minimal program to reproduce:

``` Python
import asyncio

@asyncio.coroutine
def example_coro():
    q = asyncio.Queue()
    msg = yield from q.get()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
    loop.run_until_complete(example_coro())
```
